messages:
Alex Ramos: Morning team — quick handoff for the 06:00->14:00 UTC shift. TL;DR: gpool-prod-eu steady, gpool-burst prewarmed (+2 nodes), keep an eye on 'atlas' batch window at ~09:30 UTC. I checked quotas and there's ~18% headroom on reserved capacity. Link to dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/capacity/gpool-prod-eu

Priya Nair: Thanks Alex. Do you have the expected job size for atlas? Last time they pushed a 120k token rerank and it flattened burst for 20m.

Alex Ramos: @Priya good call — they told SEs it should be small (50-80k tokens) but could run concurrent 4 jobs. I left automatic fallback to smaller-quantized model enabled for atlas (policy: fallback->rmt-l6-8q).

Jordan Lee: Noted. I'll keep the burst throttle policy visible and raise if we hit 75% sustained on gpool-burst. Current snapshot from metricsbot: 
```
oncall-bot: metric snapshot gpool-burst: util=42% (5m avg), queued=6, burst-allocated=2
oncall-bot: gpool-prod-eu: util=68% (5m avg), headroom=18%
```

Matt Chen: Ping me if atlas spawns >3 concurrent runs. I can spin a temporary dedicated slot (60m) and route via canary to avoid affecting normal customers.

Priya Nair: Quick ask — are the quota limits for embeddings different? One of atlas's jobs does embeddings before rerank. If embeddings hit egress or token limits we need to throttle earlier.

Alex Ramos: Embedding path uses prod-embed pool (separate quota). Right now prod-embed at 55% — safe. I left a note in the runbook: "if prod-embed >70% then block new atlas embeddings and notify eng-ml".

oncall-bot: FYI scheduled cronjob detected: atlas-batch-window starts 2026-06-03T09:25:00Z (expected duration 00:18:00).

Jordan Lee: I'll watch the spike, and if we cross 75% sustained on gpool-burst for >3m I'll trigger Matt's temp slot. Also will flip autoscale cooldown to 90s for the next 30m to be more responsive.

Matt Chen: Sounds good. If you need me to pre-create the slot so it's faster, say the word.

Alex Ramos: No need to pre-create — let's be conservative. If it looks like latency climbs, escalate to me and I'll approve the slot. Leaving handoff notes: 1) Keep alert thresholds at default aside from 75% burst watch. 2) Watch atlas job start window 09:20-09:40 UTC. 3) Keep me pinged in #eng-oncall if anything >5% above baseline for 10m.

Priya Nair: ACK. I'll put a quick dashboard watch on and post snapshots here if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: ACK, taking active watch.

Matt Chen: ACK, reachable if needed.

Alex Ramos: Thanks — handing off. :coffee:
